verdict.rationale: BugSnag ships an official CLI ([bugsnag-probe-4]) that creates builds and enriches releases in the dashboard ([bugsnag-docs-12]), which fits non-interactive build-pipeline steps. The official MCP server ([bugsnag-probe-3]) and webhooks ([bugsnag-docs-10]) add some scripted, headless access to error data. However, the evidence never shows CI usage explicitly and only covers release/build reporting, not broader automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless pipeline documentation (e.g. CI examples, source-map upload via CLI), CLI coverage beyond build creation, a published OpenAPI spec ([bugsnag-probe-2] 404s), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
